To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a framework for assessing freshwater environmental impact and freshwater consumption was developed and applied to a maize grain crop production system in Northern Italy.

the environmental impact of organic fertilisers spreading and irrigation techniques on maize production is strongly affected by the management of the organic fertilisers and the irrigation technology, respectively.
the environmental impact of crop production can be assessed by means of the proposed framework, which includes a new indicator for water pollution and the gross irrigation volume applied on field.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new framework proposal to evaluate the environmental impact of freshwater use and consumption.
a novel approach for assessing the freshwater consumption and environmental impact of agricultural products.

the assessment of both the consumption and the environmental impact of water in crop production, and the proposed framework permits to quantify the water footprint of the crop production, the water consumed and the pollution caused.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the most efficient irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) are recommended to be used with the best fertilisation practices (i.e. slow soil incorporation of manure) to limit the environmental impact of maize production in terms of both freshwater consumption and pollution.

, in the case of organic fertiliser spreading, the best technique in terms of PWI is the one that minimises the environmental impact of the fertiliser applied, while for irrigation, the best techniques are those with the highest technical efficiency.

the environmental impact related to the water consumed by crops can be reduced by improving irrigation technologies and reducing organic fertilisers losses, while the environmental impact related with water pollution is reduced by reducing the amount of fertilisers applied.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the environmental impact of water consumption and pollution should be assessed together in order to obtain a more comprehensive evaluation of water consumption.
the proposed framework permits to assess both environmental impact and consumption of freshwater and to evaluate the effects of different management practices on water use and environmental impact.
the proposed framework can be a useful tool to assess both the consumption and the environmental impact of freshwater, and to compare different management options in a sustainable perspective.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a new framework to assess both environmental impact and consumption of freshwater in crop production should be developed.
the proposed framework permits to quantify the freshwater consumption and the environmental impact related to water pollution.

the proposed framework permits to quantify the freshwater environmental impact and the freshwater consumed in agricultural systems, thus permitting to better assess the water sustainability of agricultural systems.
